record.name: Entrepreneur
record.description: Entrepreneurs are masters of commerce and trade, using their business acumen to create opportunities, manage resources, and turn profit from any situation.

subclass_identity_profile.core_fantasy: A master of commerce and trade, always seeking new opportunities
subclass_identity_profile.role_in_group: Merchant or leader, providing value through negotiation and deal-making
visual_signals: Wearing fine attire and accessories signifying wealth and status
Carrying a leather-bound journal to record business transactions

progression_tree.description: Gain proficiency in two skills of choice that can be used for commerce or negotiation
Gain expertise in one skill used for negotiation and deal-making
Gain the ability to analyze and improve a business's financial situation
Gain the ability to create and lead a business, bringing in customers and revenue

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: A lean, athletic stance with feet shoulder-width apart and fists clenched, radiating an aura of confident readiness to take on any challenge in the galaxy.
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: A swirling vortex of vibrant blues and whites that pulse with the rhythm of commerce and trade, as if the very fabric of space-time is infused with the entrepreneurial spirit.

prompt_schema.base_prompt: A resourceful Entrepreneur, clad in a worn leather jacket and clutching a trusty Blaster Pistol, navigates the bustling streets of Coruscant, eyes scanning for new opportunities to expand their business empire.
contextual_modifiers: add a group of shady-looking Trandoshans lurking in the shadows
